messages:
Maya (Eng Platform): Quick sync — next Architecture Review Board is Wed 10/15 16:00 PT. We need a facilitator. Kai mentioned wanting to step up but asked to shadow first. Thinking: pair facilitation (lead + shadow) for this cycle so we can onboard new leads. Thoughts?

Kai S: I can lead and have Maya shadow, or I can shadow if someone else wants to lead. Either works for me. I prefer lead if it's just running the agenda & timeboxing. :+1: 

Jon R: Pair facilitation sounds good. Also would like to try a compact agenda format: 10m triage, 20m RFC deep dive, 15m design review, 5m action items. Keeps things sharp.

Olivia P: I have the KV cache eviction RFC ready for review (PR linked). Can present a 10–12m walkthrough + Qs. If Kai leads, I can slot that as the RFC deep dive. @Maya can you add it to the agenda?

Maya (Eng Platform): Yep I'll add it. Also a quick triage item: the cross-region rollout had two flapping instances — want <5m to confirm next-step plan.

Kai S: Perfect. I'll take lead facilitation and run the timer. Maya can handle notes and follow-ups. If anyone wants to shadow in the future, we can rotate every other meeting.

Jon R: One ask — can we try starting at :02 past the hour to allow people to join after the hour backlog? Small change but helps.

Maya (Eng Platform): Fine by me. I'll schedule for 16:02 PT and post the calendar invite. Agenda draft below — please call out edits.

Maya (Eng Platform): ```
Agenda (60m total)
- 16:02 — 16:07: Quick triage & incidents (Maya)
- 16:07 — 16:27: RFC: KV cache eviction policy (Olivia, 12m + Qs)
- 16:27 — 16:42: Design review: cross-shard caching fallback (Jon, 12m + Qs)
- 16:42 — 16:55: Platform standards: deployment tagging & rollout policy (Kai, 10m)
- 16:55 — 17:02: Actions & next facilitator sign-up (Kai + Maya)
```

Olivia P: That looks good. I'll keep slides to 6–8 slides and a short demo.

Jon R: I'll prep the design notes and link the prototype in the calendar.

TriageBot: Automated note — there are 2 recent incidents tagged #cross-region-rollout in the last 72h. Assigned: eng-runtime. (link)

Maya (Eng Platform): Thanks. Two quick asks before I finalize: 1) anyone need remote-friendly timing tweak? 2) who wants to be shadowed next cycle (we'll rotate leads)? Please react or reply by EOD Tuesday so I can lock the invite.

Kai S: I'll be lead this cycle; happy to be shadowed by Jon or someone new next time.

Olivia P: Works for me. No timing changes.

Jon R: I can shadow next time.

Maya (Eng Platform): Great — locking it in. Invite + agenda up in 10. Thanks all :tada:
